AI Mentor System Architecture

Components, services, ports, volumes, and connections — everything you need to know to maintain the platform

Ops Guide — 1 of 6

Overview

AI Mentor is a RAG platform for technical documentation. It accepts PDF, Swagger, Protobuf, Confluence, and other formats, indexes them via Gemini Embedding, and serves answers through a Web Chat (Gemini Pro) and an MCP Server (for IDEs).

The platform is deployed on a single VPS. All services except Nginx run in Docker Compose. Nginx is installed on the host and managed via systemd.

Stack Backend: Python 3.11 / FastAPI / Celery. Frontend: React 19 / Vite / TypeScript. DB: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector. Cache/Broker: Redis 7. Storage: MinIO (S3). LLM: Gemini 2.5 Pro + Flash.

Docker Services

All services are defined in docker-compose.yml. Worker and Beat use the same ai-mentor-backend image as the API — they do not have a separate build.

Worker and Beat do not have their own build. They use image: ai-mentor-backend, which is built by the api service. Therefore, docker compose build api updates the code for all three.

Host Services

Nginx is installed on the host via systemd, not in Docker. It terminates TLS, serves frontend static files, and proxies requests to the API.

nginx
systemd on host
:80 → :443reverse proxyTLS terminationstatic files
Nginx Config is stored in the repository: nginx/ai-mentor.conf. On the server, it is copied to /etc/nginx/sites-available/ai-mentor.conf. Frontend static files are in /var/www/ai-mentor/.

The only public port is 443 (Nginx). All other services are not accessible from the outside. Grafana and MinIO Console are available only via SSH tunnel or localhost.

Docker Volumes

All data is stored in named Docker volumes. When containers are removed, the data is preserved.

VolumeServiceContentsCriticality
pgdatapostgresAll DB data: users, documents, chunks, embeddingsCritical
redisdataredisCelery queues, embedding cacheRecoverable
minio_dataminioOriginal document files, converted MarkdownCritical
lokidatalokiLogs for 30 daysNon-critical
grafanadatagrafanaSaved dashboards and settingsRecoverable from repository
prometheusdataprometheusMetrics (CPU, RAM, containers)Non-critical
pgdata and minio_data are unrecoverable without backups. Automatic backup is not yet configured. It is recommended to set up pg_dump cron and MinIO bucket versioning.

Health Endpoints

EndpointWhat it checksWhen to use
GET /healthNothing — always {"status": "ok"}Liveness probe: is the uvicorn process alive
GET /readyPostgreSQL (SELECT 1), Redis (PING), S3 (check_health), LLM (check_health)Readiness probe: is the service ready to accept requests
API health checkcurl -sf http://localhost:8000/health && echo OK || echo FAIL
Full check (all dependencies)curl -s http://localhost:8000/ready | python3 -m json.tool

Logging (Overview)

All logs in JSON → stdout → Promtail → Loki → Grafana. Additionally written to disk files (rotation by size and date).

FileLevelFormatRotation
stdoutAllJSON (for Promtail)Docker json-file: 10MB × 3
app.logINFO+Human-readable50MB + daily, 30 days
error.logERROR+Human-readable50MB + daily, 30 days
access.logINFO+Human-readable50MB + daily, 30 days
Real-time API logsdocker compose logs -f api --tail 100
